## Standing operator rules
All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name `sms:delivery_attempt` in the metrics label. Do not raise the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50; it caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.

Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so the dunning email scheduler does not send reminders to customers who already paid. Router splitting and billing-event retention work are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`get_user_record` → `fetch_account`. Current sandbox payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded and shut down. `billing/currency.py`: `round_money(amount, places=2)`, `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Shared billing parser helper: `_add_billing_filters(parser)`. New test: `test_billing_filter_abbreviations_parse`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pool size 50 causes deadlocks. Popping before `record_usage_event()` loses events on persistence failure. Retaining a shared batch or `self.completed_batches` retains charged-event payloads.

## Plan and progress
Done: billing retention regression passed; full suite passed (`118 passed, 7 skipped`); parser deduplication passed (`37 passed`); Ruff and `git diff --check` passed. Added abbreviation regression; test status unknown.

Pending: inspect dunning scheduler/tests, then run exact test: `python -m pytest tests/dunning -q`

## Recent work
Removed duplicate `--currency`, updated typed CLI assertions, wrapped long help strings, and verified abbreviated filters. Added `test_billing_filter_abbreviations_parse` without running it afterward.
